meta.method_signature: parallel multi-agent research + verification against primary sources
method: Architects REGISTERED with the official body of their country — not graduates, not de facto practitioners. Where registration runs through an engineers' union (glyph ▤), the architecture division's own headcount is given when one exists.

A — nominal list downloadable in bulk (open data, roster, published register). B — public register searchable online, no download. C — official headcount published, register not searchable. D — estimate or association list only.

Every headcount is dated and sourced (link in the record). Europe: cross-checked against the ACE 2024 sector study. World: set against the list of the UIA's 117 member sections. Alternative lists (associations such as RIBA or AIA, directories) are given country by country.

Japan: the ~370,000 first-class kenchikushi are mostly building engineers — the figure is not comparable to an architects' order. Federal states (United States, Canada, Australia, Argentina, Germany…): registration is subnational and the aggregate comes from the coordinating body. South Africa: SACAP counts several categories, only « professional architects » are retained. Greece and the Arab world: registration is merged with engineers.
Architects per 100,000 inhabitants, UN 2024 population rounded — an order-of-magnitude indicator, not a fine statistic.

A worldwide directory of named individuals. Lists of people stay with their publishers and are linked from here; the raw harvested files are kept outside the public repository (GDPR) — the catalogue keeps the link to every source.

countries.body: South African Council for the Architectural Profession
countries.notes: Statutory council (Architectural Profession Act 44 of 2000). Category PITFALL: 2023/24 report = 11,564 registrants across ALL categories: 4,418 Professional Architects, 1,931 Senior Technologists, 1,116 Technologists, 1,371 Draughtspersons, 2,437 candidates… — count only the 4,418 PrArch. Searchable register (search by name), no downloadable list. SAIA = UIA section.

countries.body: Conseil National de l'Ordre des Architectes
countries.notes: Legislative decree no. 94-07 of 18 May 1994, amended by law no. 04-06 (texts on cnoa.dz). The national register is NOT published online. The local wilaya councils used to publish lists, but their sites are dead (Mostaganem listed ~168 approved architects according to a cached copy). No sourced national headcount (fr+ar). UIA membership formalised at the Copenhagen congress, July 2023. The order is in recurrent crisis (a former president convicted, 2023).
countries.uia_section: Conseil national de l'Ordre des architectes

countries.body: Ordem dos Arquitectos de Angola
countries.notes: UIA section. “Lista Oficial dos Arquitectos Inscritos” no. 9 (year 2024, online February 2025): 37-page nominal PDF, counted = 2,056 registrants (OA-0001 onwards; list no. 8 of August 2024: 1,876) — cumulative list. Admission by examination (the 12th scheduled for October 2026). Seat at Vila Alice, Luanda. Direct count of the Lista oficial 2024 (PDF of 13 February 2025), carried out on 5 August 2026: exactly 2,056, continuous index 1..2056; earlier state of August 2024: 1,876 registrants (+180 in six months).

countries.body: Architects Registration Council
countries.notes: Board under Cap 61:08; annual register published as web tables: 2025 = 274 architects + 67 technologists + 9 draughtspersons — count only the 274. Bounded scopes of practice: technologist ≤250 m², draughtsperson ≤150 m². AAB = UIA section. CORRECTION 5 August 2026 (direct count of the 2025 register): 275 architects — the printed ranks stop at 274 but one line (01240350) is entered without a rank; + 68 technologists and 9 draughtspersons in the corpus annexes.

countries.body: Ordre des Architectes du Burkina Faso
countries.notes: Active order: swearing-in ceremonies (18 admitted in 2016, 35 in 2021), a “Semaine de l’Architecte” (7 editions), president Ada Yaya Bocoum. A preliminary draft of a new law was undergoing validation (August 2024) — no law in force found, hence the obligations left null. The architectes.bf site is dead (DNS); no register and no headcount. Member of the Conférence des ordres UEMOA.
countries.uia_section: Ordre des Architectes du Burkina Faso (OAB)

countries.body: Association Burundaise des Architectes (no approved professional order)
countries.notes: No professional order: Abarchi (campaigning since 1980) was still seeking its official approval in 2013 — “anyone can claim to practise” (Iwacu, 17 June 2013). No creation of an order traced since; the regulation requiring plans drawn by architects “was never formalised”. No UIA member.

countries.body: Ordre National des Architectes et des Urbanistes du Bénin (formerly ONAB)
countries.notes: “Tableau de l’Ordre 2025 arrêté au 31 décembre 2024” (PDF verified): institution created by decree no. 83-388 of 1 November 1983. Count: full members no. 001 to 244 (sworn and authorised) + trainees no. 245 to 264. Online directory (onaub.com/annuaire). TRAP: the former site onabenin.org is dead but still indexed; ONAB renamed ONAUB (town planners brought in). Press 2022: 215→226 members — consistent with 244 at the end of 2024. Direct count from the register as at 31 December 2024 (official PDF) on 5 August 2026: 159 architects + 5 town planners (the order covers both professions) + 18 trainees = 182 persons; the earlier “244” is not found in the document — the historical numbering runs up to 264 with 84 numbers struck off/deceased not listed (a stock probably never cleared). A second count using the “Serment :” entries agrees.
countries.uia_section: Ordre national des architectes et urbanistes du Bénin

countries.body: Ordre National des Architectes du Cameroun
countries.notes: Law no. 75/12 of 8 December 1975 (the first professional order in Cameroon; first registrant on 2 April 1962). Public, paginated online register: counters in August 2026 = 829 registrants since creation, 502 authorised to practise, 375 trainees. Press coverage of the fiftieth anniversary (2025): 663 registrants, of whom 419 in practice, ~14.5% women, 81 practices. No official export. Beware the multiple sites: onac-noca.org (official), onac-noca.com, onac18.africa.
countries.uia_section: Ordre national des architectes du Cameroun (ONAC)

countries.body: Ordem dos Arquitectos de Cabo Verde
countries.notes: Statutes approved by Decreto-Lei n° 60/99 (framework Lei n° 126/IV/95); covers architects and urban planners. Site arquitectos.org.cv (oac.cv parked). “Arquitetos” section with neither list nor headcount accessible. UIA section.

countries.body: No body identified
countries.notes: No order and no association identified (the local press cites no professional body). No UIA member.

countries.body: No body identified
countries.notes: No order and no association identified. No UIA member.

countries.body: Ordre des Architectes du Congo
countries.notes: Active order: forum in Brazzaville (November 2022), president Antoine Beli Bokolodjoue, general meeting of the federation of francophone architects of Africa. Legal basis, register and headcount not found; no official website.

countries.body: Ordre des Architectes de Côte d'Ivoire — Conseil National de l'Ordre
countries.notes: Law no. 2018-868 of 19 November 2018 (art. 8: title and practice reserved to those on the register — verified in the PDF). Half-yearly register circulated as a PDF (press copy verified; the official site oarchitectes.ci is alive). Two sections under a single continuous numbering: architects approved for private practice, then civil servants, salaried architects and consultants. TRAPS: oarchitectes.ci contains injected spam (casino); the official online directory is down (Supabase quota exceeded, error 402 observed). President: Joseph Amon (re-elected February 2025). Confirmed by direct count on 5 August 2026 (the poster read in full as rendered): exactly 239 = 151 approved architects in private practice + 88 civil servants/salaried architects/consultants — breakdown obtained.
countries.uia_section: Conseil national de l'Ordre des architectes de Côte d'Ivoire (CNOA-CI)

countries.body: No body identified
countries.notes: No order and no association identified. No UIA member.

countries.body: Architects, Engineers, Surveyors and Allied Professionals Registration Council
countries.notes: MIXED council created by Act no. 15 of 2013; the act provides for a register and for site audits. No operational site (aesap.org.sz does not resolve); headcount and register not public. No UIA section.

countries.body: Ordre Gabonais des Architectes (Conseil supérieur)
countries.notes: Active order under ministerial supervision: general meeting on 23 November 2024, revision of the internal rules, election of the Conseil supérieur scheduled for February 2025; president elected: Erichk Mauro. Founding instrument not found; no official website, register or headcount — coverage by the press (Gabonreview).
countries.uia_section: Conseil national de l'Ordre des architectes gabonais

countries.body: No body identified
countries.notes: No Gambian architects’ act, board or institute found online. No UIA section.

countries.body: Architects Registration Council
countries.notes: State board under the Architects Act 1969 (NLCD 357). Complete nominal list online: 744 architects in good standing as at 30 April 2026, numbered 1-744 (web page); the home page displays the cumulative totals 1,429+ licensed professionals, 258+ firms, 200+ probationers; 2023 report: 1,270 registrants, of whom 650 in good standing — the cumulative total and the in-good-standing figure must be carefully distinguished. GIA = UIA section. Confirmed by direct count on 5 August 2026: 744 exactly (ranks 1-744 continuous, double-checked); + 111 practices and 164 PPE trainees in the corpus annexes.

countries.body: Ordre National des Architectes de Guinée (Chambre Nationale des Architectes at the UIA)
countries.notes: President: Boubacar Bah (Guineenews 2020-2026). Framework: the 1985 “code de l’Architecture” still in force, judged “anachronistic”; the new code tabled around 2010 was never approved — hence the obligations left null despite the existence of “approved practices”. No official website, register or headcount.
countries.uia_section: Chambre nationale des architectes de Guinée

countries.body: No body identified
countries.notes: No order and no association identified (pt+fr). No UIA member. Architects trained in Portugal/Senegal/Brazil.

countries.body: Board of Registration of Architects and Quantity Surveyors
countries.notes: Board under Cap 525; register covering architects AND quantity surveyors — count only the architects. Direct count of Gazette Notice no. 2595 of 07.02.2025 (official PDF, in good standing as at 31 January 2025), carried out on 5 August 2026: 1,226 architects — S/No continuous 1-1226, two misprints in the gazette (“Arh.”, one missing title) checked by hand. This corrects the count of 699 taken from the site index (a cross-check planned from the initial harvest onwards). Same gazette: 833 quantity surveyors (no. 2596), 263 architectural practices (no. 2597), 166 quantity surveying practices (no. 2598). AAK (1967, 8 chapters, directory members.aak.or.ke/directory) = UIA section.

countries.body: Architectural Association of Lesotho
countries.notes: No registration act found: the AAL is an association (Societies Act 1966) with an online directory; 8 “Active Members / Verified Professionals” displayed — very low coverage, not to be taken for the whole body of practitioners. No UIA section.

countries.body: General Union of Engineering Professions (النقابة العامة للمهن الهندسية)
countries.notes: No separate professional order: registration goes through the engineering professions union (regulated elections in December 2024). The Libyan Institute of Architects represents the profession at the UIA. No register and no headcount published (ar+fr). Fragmented situation post-2011.

countries.body: Architects’ Registration Board (created by the Architects’ Act of 2023)
countries.notes: Emerging regime: the 2023 Act creates a board, installed by the LIA (press 2023-2024). No public register and no headcount as yet. No UIA section.

countries.body: Ordre des Architectes de Madagascar
countries.notes: The order exists and is active: president Fara Rahoeliarivahy (2025); public advocacy; plan for a national school of architecture (2025, with Morocco). Legal basis, official website (architectes.mg: dead DNS), register and headcount not found.

countries.body: Board of Architects and Quantity Surveyors
countries.notes: Board established by the 1991 Act (Cap 53:02), the registration and disciplinary authority (architects + QS). No official site and no online register; the scope of the registration requirement has not been verified. No UIA section listed.

countries.body: Ordre des Architectes du Mali
countries.notes: Established by law no. 89-17/AN-RM of 1 March 1989; framework reformed in 2025 to align with UEMOA directive no. 07/2005 (free movement of architects). Compulsory registration attested by the ESIAU litigation. No official website and no register online (a Facebook presence); no sourced headcount. UIA section.

countries.body: Ordre National des Architectes — Conseil National de l'Ordre des Architectes
countries.notes: Headcount = the 2024 CNOA electorate: 2,685 registrants in the private sector + 214 in the public sector (press citing the order). Law no. 016-89 (promulgated 1993). A “Tableau de l’Ordre” page exists on cnoa.ma but is rendered in JavaScript; the portal is members-only. Higher figures (~6,000) circulate that include those not on the register and civil servants.

countries.body: Professional Architects' Council
countries.notes: Council created by the PAC Act 2011; the title “Architect” is reserved for registrants. “List of Professional Architects Registered for the Year 2026” published in full as a web table: 331 architects, plus a list of mentors. MAA = UIA section. Seat at Quatre Bornes. CORRECTION 5 August 2026 (direct count of the 2026 table): 274 architects — the 331 was the HIGHEST registration number, not the headcount (57 numbers struck off, listed in the corpus); the 150 “Employment Mentors” are a status, all of them already on the register.

countries.body: Ordre Mauritanien des Architectes (ambiguous status: association/order)
countries.notes: The press refers variously to an “association de l’Ordre Mauritanien des Architectes” (2017) and to an “Ordre des Architectes” (Financial Afrik, 2024). No law establishing an order, no register and no headcount found. Absent from the UIA. A national school of architecture is planned with Moroccan support (2026).

countries.body: Ordem dos Arquitectos de Moçambique
countries.notes: Order created by Lei n° 13/2017 (public law, compulsory registration; architects, urban planners, planning). Social media presence (@oarqmoc) but NO official site and no list of registrants; no headcount published. Lusophone sphere (CIALP); no UIA section listed.

countries.body: Namibia Council for Architects and Quantity Surveyors
countries.notes: Council under Act 13 of 1979 (inherited from South African law). Public search via search.mymembership.co.za (the same platform as SACAP). ±132 registered architects + 108 in training across 81 practices (NIA figures) — no official NCAQS statistic. No UIA section listed.

countries.body: Ordre National des Architectes du Niger
countries.notes: Active order: entry on the register + a 24-month traineeship + an oath before the Cour d’État (17 newly sworn in on 28 June 2024, Le Sahel). Founding instrument not found; no headcount and no register online. Absent from the UIA. ARCHIMAT trade fair (2025).

countries.body: Architects Registration Council of Nigeria
countries.notes: Board created by Decree 10 of 1969 (Architects Act Cap A19 LFN 2004); distinct from the NIA (association founded 1960, ~12,000 members across all grades, UIA section; the 2022 ARCON-NIA conflict resolved). 4,926 registrants announced by the ARCON president in July 2021; mass inductions since (526 in 2025), so the actual headcount is higher. “Register of Architects and Architectural Firms” page with no public PDF; online verification portal operational. Categories: architects, technologists, firms.

countries.body: Architects Registration Board
countries.notes: Statutory board (Architects Registration Act 1996). PDF “Architects List for 2026” (5 June 2026) counted: 269 architects (numbers 002 to 404, register with gaps), with Practicing Certificate, qualifications and contact details. Members’ portal myarb.info. The Uganda Society of Architects (USA) is the UIA section. CORRECTION 5 August 2026 (direct count of the PDF “Architects List for 2026”): 269 practitioners holding the 2026 certificate — lifetime Reg/No 002-404 with 134 gaps (registrants without a certificate), second count by PC/No 26xxx (269 = 269); the earlier 273 came from a previous edition of the same living list.

countries.body: Ordre National des Architectes de la RDC
countries.notes: Law no. 18/034 of 13 December 2018 (practice of the profession). Online directory with a public search engine (onadrc.com); a second official site architectes-rdc.cd — a past battle over legitimacy (contested elections in 2021; current president: Fiyou Ndondoboni Monkoso, 2025). Approval numbers observed up to ~0585; no total headcount published. Hosted the 14th congress of the Union des Architectes d’Afrique (Kinshasa 2025).

countries.body: Rwanda Institute of Architects (with its Board of Registration)
countries.notes: Law no. 26/2012, REPLACED by law no. 023/2025 of 1 September 2025, now being implemented (notice of January 2026: annual licence compulsory, 2026 list of “eligible architects”). “Over 200 members” (ria.rw — a lower bound). Public directories by category with a 2025-2026 licence-holder filter, rendered in JavaScript (not countable without a browser). The IER covers engineers.

countries.body: Seychelles Licensing Authority (architectural services licences)
countries.notes: Neither professional order nor board: a licence from the Seychelles Licensing Authority (recognised degree or proof of competence). The “Construction Professional Registration Bill 2022” provided for a Council with a register — adoption not verified. No public headcount. No UIA section.

countries.body: Sierra Leone Institute of Architects
countries.notes: Institute and regulator are one and the same: the SLIA regulates the profession under the Architects Act 1986; admission by examination (4 inducted in July 2024). UIA section; joined the CAA in 2023. No register and no headcount published.

countries.body: No statutory body identified
countries.notes: No legal regime specific to architects. SIA founded 2023 (post-conflict reconstruction). Engineers register with the Ministry of Public Works (mpwr.gov.so). No UIA section.

countries.body: Sudanese Engineering Council
countries.notes: Architects register alongside engineers with the Sudanese Engineering Council (titles of the “Specialist Architect” type). The Sudanese Institute of Architects is the UIA section. War since 2023: institutions in disarray, no public register and no public headcount.

countries.body: No body specific to architects
countries.notes: No architects’ board and no architects’ institute. The SSES covers engineers, architects and technologists; an Engineering Council regulates engineering. First school of architecture (Univ. of Juba) created in 2020. No UIA section.

countries.body: Ordem dos Engenheiros e Arquitectos de São Tomé e Príncipe
countries.notes: MIXED engineers-and-architects order; registration opened in 2024 (CIALP source). No site of its own, no register and no headcount. No UIA section.

countries.body: Ordre des Architectes du Sénégal
countries.notes: “No one may practise unless entered on the register” (ODAS website). Framework: laws no. 78-43 and no. 78-44 of 6 July 1978 (to be confirmed in the Journal officiel). The website displays “282 members” (2026); the PDF “Tableau ODAS 2025” (January 2025) has ~231 lines. Online directory. Press, May 2024: ~260 registrants, 1 architect per ~500,000 inhabitants. Direct count from the PDF “Tableau ODAS 2025” (January 2025 edition) on 5 August 2026: 189 architects on the register (168 in category A, private practice; 5 in category C, civil servants; 10 in category R.A, UEMOA reception; 6 honorary) + 25 trainees (category D) + firms (category B). The gap with the “282 members” on the website (2026) remains unexplained — a more recent edition of the register is likely.

countries.body: Architects and Quantity Surveyors Registration Board
countries.notes: Board under Act no. 4/2010 (Cap 269), seat in Dodoma. Complete public list on the ORS portal, counted by crawling: 1,944 professionals, of whom 693 architects (960 QS, 94 technologists, 35 interior architects…) — count only the 693. AAT = UIA section. Confirmed by direct count on 5 August 2026 (crawl of the 6 ORS pages): 693 exactly (671 Local + 22 Foreign) out of the Board’s 1,944 professionals — of which 961 quantity surveyors, in the corpus annexes.

countries.body: Ordre National des Architectes du Tchad
countries.notes: Created in 2012 by decree; art. 7: title and practice reserved to those on the register (press conference of 17 May 2025). “More than 150 members”, of whom 6 women (38 at the time of creation). The 2025 register was presented publicly but not published online. President: Senoussi Ahmat Senoussi (re-elected January 2026). UIA membership announced in 2021. An architecture bill is under consideration (2024).
countries.uia_section: Ordre national des architectes du Tchad

countries.body: Ordre National des Architectes du Togo
countries.notes: The Order’s register as at 31 March 2026, unveiled on 29 April 2026: 168 architects (143 m / 25 f) + 68 practices (the official portal headlines “167” — a discrepancy of one). 2024: 126 architects + 58 practices. The full register can be downloaded from onat.tg, but as a JPEG IMAGE, not a PDF. Decree no. 94-117/PMRT (code of professional conduct). UIA membership in July 2023 (Copenhagen). President of the Conseil supérieur: Péyébinesso Limazie. CONFIRMED 5 August 2026 by full visual transcription of the poster (3 agents, overlapping bands, zero name conflicts): exactly 168 (163 in private practice + 5 civil servants, numbers 005-247 with 75 gaps) — the portal’s “167” is now settled; 68 practices confirmed + 9 trainees in the corpus annexes; oath years captured (cohorts 1996-2025).
countries.uia_section: Ordre national des architectes du Togo (ONAT)

countries.body: Ordre des Architectes de Tunisie
countries.notes: Law no. 74-46 of 22 May 1974 (“no one may bear the title or practise without being entered on the register”). Complete 2025 register in PDF, direct count: 2,118 in private practice + 63 others + 482 salaried in the private sector = 2,663 names. TRAP: the TLS certificate of oat.tn is broken (incomplete chain). The press diverges: “more than 3,000” (2024), “6,267” (Tuniscope, not corroborated). The 2012-2023 registers are also online. Direct count from the PDF on 5 August 2026: exactly 2,663, continuity by section — 2,118 in private practice, 482 salaried in the private sector, 51 public-sector employees, 12 teaching and research academics (the modes of practice under art. 10, as at 31 December 2024).

countries.body: Zambia Institute of Architects
countries.notes: Hybrid case: the institute IS the statutory authority — Zambia Institute of Architects Act (Cap 442, 1995). UIA section. Register not published: access through the members’ portal; the site returns 403 to robots; no official headcount online.

countries.body: Architects Council of Zimbabwe
countries.notes: Statutory council (Architects Act Ch. 27:01, 1976). Public list on the joint IAZ/ACZ site, counted: 64 names — probably partial (active practitioners), to be treated with caution. No UIA section listed.

countries.body: Egyptian Engineers Syndicate (نقابة المهندسين), architecture division
countries.notes: Architects are registered WITH the engineers in the syndicate (laws 66/1947 then 66/1974; membership required in order to practise), within the architecture division. The division’s headcount has never been published (searches in AR/EN); all divisions: 470,000 (2012), >500,000 cited at the 2024 elections, ~30,000 new members a year. The SEA is the UIA section; syndicate site eea.org.eg.

countries.body: No body identified
countries.notes: No online trace of an Eritrean board, professional order or association of architects; only private practices. No UIA section.

countries.body: Ministry of Urban Development / Ethiopian Construction Authority (registration of professionals)
countries.notes: Particular regime: neither a professional order nor a board — registration/certificate of competence with the ministry (directive no. 718/2021). Ministerial register not public, no headcount found. The AEA (August 1991, Addis Ababa) is the UIA section; ≈2,000 members cited by secondary sources, not confirmed on aea.et.

countries.body: Provincial colegios and consejos (24 jurisdictions), federated by the Federación Argentina de Entidades de Arquitectos
countries.notes: Regulation PROVINCE BY PROVINCE: matrícula compulsory in each jurisdiction; in the City of Buenos Aires, the CPAU (Decreto-Ley 6070/1958 ratified by Ley 14.467). Headcount: “115,000 matriculados en todas las entidades” (first FADEA meeting of 2023, relayed by the Misiones colegio; 105,000 cited during COVID). No single national register: public padrones PROVINCE BY PROVINCE (verified: CAPSF Santa Fe; Córdoba publishes a monthly list). PITFALL: cpau.org is an SPA (every URL returns 200). FADEA = UIA section; fadea.org.ar publishes no figures.
countries.uia_section: Federación Argentina de Entidades de Arquitectos (FADEA)

countries.body: Institute of Bahamian Architects (existence reported, not verified online)
countries.notes: Verification not completed: no official site reachable, quota exhausted before confirmation; the exact status and the existence of a registration law are TO BE CONFIRMED — null rather than invented values. Absent from the UIA sections.

countries.body: Barbados Institute of Architects (self-regulating organisation, founded 1968)
countries.notes: The BIA site presents itself as “the nation's self-regulating body”: 53 Full Members (+21 associates, 26 affiliates, 8 students) — headcount = members of the association, NOT a statutory register. An “A.R.B” section with licensure guidance: a statutory law/register, recent or in progress — NOT confirmed. Searchable directory. Absent from the UIA sections.

countries.body: Association of Professional Architects of Belize (statutory registrar under the Professional Architects (Registration) Act, 2003)
countries.notes: 2003 Act, s. 15(1): no one may practise without registration; the APAB keeps the register by delegation. “Registered Architects 2026” list in HTML with contact details (≈50 names counted). Permits over 3,000 sq ft: the signature of a registered architect is required. Absent from the list of UIA sections.

countries.body: Colegio de Arquitectos de Bolivia — Registro Nacional de Arquitectos
countries.notes: Ley 1373 of 13 November 1992 (text verified on lexivox.org): registration in the Registro Nacional de Arquitectos is COMPULSORY (arts. 6-7); no project has legal validity without the signature of an authorised architect (art. 5). The official site displays “20,000 Arquitectos Afiliados” — a self-declared round figure, with neither date nor method. No online consultation of the RNA (grade C). Structured by departmental colegios.

countries.body: Conselho de Arquitetura e Urbanismo do Brasil
countries.notes: Lei 12.378/2010 (verified): compulsory registro, practice and title protected, one RRT per project. Live counter verified on 5 August 2026 on “Ache um Arquiteto”: 244,604 active professionals (public nominal directory). IGEO (igeo.caubr.gov.br) advertises “consulta, visualização e download” (official article of 16 April 2025: 236,085 architects, 37,180 firms, 11.67 M RRT). PITFALL: caubr.gov.br and transparencia return 403 to robots/from outside Brazil — the bulk nominal export could not be verified from abroad, hence B and not A (very probably available through IGEO/dados abertos). UIA: the Brazilian section is the IAB, not the CAU. Attempt of 5 August 2026: igeo.caubr.gov.br AND transparencia.caubr.gov.br/dadosabertos return 403 from outside Brazil (verified) — the nominal harvest will have to wait for local access or help on the ground.

countries.body: 11 provincial and territorial orders (OAQ, OAA, AIBC, AAA…), grouped within the ROAC (formerly CALA)
countries.notes: No national aggregate published by the ROAC (roac.ca, verified). Sourced for the large provinces: OAQ 4,398 members as at 31 March 2022 (Aviseo socio-economic study, December 2023, verified); OAA 4,924 architects in 2023 (+1,991 trainees; Annual Report 2023, verified) — ≈9,300 for QC+ON. Public directories held by each order (OAQ “Trouver un architecte”, OAA Directory…), searchable but not downloadable. The UIA member is the RAIC (association); regulation remains provincial.

countries.body: Colegio de Arquitectos de Chile (VOLUNTARY membership since 1981)
countries.notes: A documented REVERSE CASE: Decreto Ley 3.621 of 3 February 1981 (text verified on LeyChile) turned the colegios into asociaciones gremiales and PROHIBITED making membership a condition of practice (art. 2). Practice rests on the university degree (checked for the signing of permits — hence protected title). The RNA “Registro Nacional de Arquitectos Colegiados” can be searched by RUT (registrocolegiados.cl, verified) but covers ONLY voluntary members — grade D: no count of the profession as a whole exists. No recent headcount verifiable. UIA section: Colegio de Arquitectos de Chile.

countries.body: Consejo Profesional Nacional de Arquitectura y sus Profesiones Auxiliares
countries.notes: Compulsory national matrícula profesional (Ley 435 de 1998). 96,335 professionals holding a matrícula as at 30 November 2025 (the CPNAA's Datos Abiertos page, verified; 76,985 in October 2019). Search by cédula through the Oficina Virtual (account required); list of those sanctioned public. Genuine OPEN DATA: Socrata dataset on datos.gov.co (pymi-7cgj, verified through the API: 5,702 rows, updated 29 July 2026) — PITFALL: it covers only the matrículas issued since 1 January 2025 and is anonymised (no names); + XLSX aggregated by department/gender. Annual flow: 3,848 matrículas issued in 2024. SCA = UIA section.

countries.body: Col·legi Oficial d'Arquitectes d'Andorra
countries.notes: The “llista d'arquitectes en exercici” publishes all practising registrants in full (name, address, col·legiat number) on a single HTML page — 94 entries counted on 5 August 2026 (numbers issued up to 198; 2022 press: ~138 col·legiats in all). Separate list for architects in public administration. No CSV or PDF despite the list being complete. Not to be confused with the Col·legi d'Arquitectes Tècnics. CORRECTION 5 August 2026 (direct count): 133 architects en exercici — the 94 counted ONLY the masculine token “Número de col·legiat” and missed the 37 “col·legiada” (women); plus 21 not in practice, 15 técnics, 26 perits in annexes; a 7th list, “administració pública”, seen in the menu, not harvested. COMPLETED 5 August 2026: 7th list “arquitectes a l'administració pública” harvested — 11 architects (Govern d'Andorra ×4, comuns ×7; 3 col·legiades), ZERO overlap with the other six lists (their numbers fill gaps in the 1-198 series); active headcount = 133 en exercici + 11 in administration = 144, the same rule as Tunisia/CI for public servants.

alternative_lists.nom: Union of Architects of Armenia (Հայաստանի ճարտարապետների միություն)

countries.notes: DOWNLOADABLE nominal State register (XLSX verified, 28 June 2026): 3,146 certificates for 2,193 individuals — BUT group 01 (town-planning documents) expressly EXCLUDES the architectural parts; architecture appears only under expert appraisal (code 02.01: 16 certificates). It is impossible to count design architects — headcount left null despite good-quality open data. Union of Architects: 643 members (year unknown), UIA member; uaa.am offline. Pitfall: do not present the 2,193 certificate holders as architects.

countries.body: Bundeskammer der Ziviltechniker:innen (4 regional chambers, architects + engineers)
countries.notes: Ziviltechnikergesetz 2019: membership of the joint architects-and-engineers chamber follows automatically. As at 31 December 2025: 4,718 architects (3,181 in practice, 1,537 dormant) out of 9,798 members — statistics page verified; the ACE estimated 6,000. Do not confuse total headcount with an active authorisation (Befugnis).

countries.body: No individual register — activity licences issued to legal entities (State Committee for Urban Planning and Architecture)
countries.notes: The State Committee (arxkom.gov.az, verified) keeps NO register of architects (master plans, permits, register of BUILDINGS). Licences to legal entities (2016 law); e-qanun.az and icaze.gov.az unreachable at the time of testing. The Union of memarlar (1934/36, UIA section, uaa.az verified) does not publish its headcount. Any estimate would be invented — no public nominal data.

countries.body: Ordre des architectes / Orde van Architecten (two wings: Vlaamse Raad and Conseil francophone et germanophone)
countries.notes: Law of 20 February 1939 (protection of the title and of the profession) + law of 26 June 1963 (the Order). As at 31 December 2024: 8,282 registrants in Flanders + 6,069 on the French-speaking side = 14,351 natural persons, EXCLUDING 1,597 trainees and 4,618 legal persons (Jaarverslag 2024, verified); ACE: 15,900. Figures split between two linguistic wings and ten provincial councils; the UIA section is the FAB, not the Order. Public search also available via ordredesarchitectes.be.

countries.body: State qualification attestation (Ministry of Architecture and Construction), operated by РУП “Белстройцентр”
countries.notes: An Аттестат квалификационный is required for regulated functions (Code of architectural and town-planning activity, 17.07.2023, ch. 8); examinations and register held by Belstroycentr. A nominal register is said to exist online (rcuk.bsc.by/att_search) but the WHOLE .by domain remained unreachable from this network (403/DNS) — URLs not verified and therefore not delivered; no aggregate headcount found. BSA (founded 1935, UIA member): 720 members (bsa.by snippet) to “more than 1,000” (Russian Wikipedia) — discrepancy not settled.

alternative_lists.nom: Asocijacija arhitekata u Bosni i Hercegovini (AABH)
Inžinjerska komora FBiH (sans pouvoir de licence)

countries.notes: Competence split between the entities. FBiH: the FMPU publishes a public nominal table of authorised persons — ≈2,157 people, of whom 226 under “Arhitektura” (direct count, August 2026); the headcount shown covers ONLY the Federation. RS: ministerial licences, with no consolidated public list found. The title is not protected as such (activity authorisations). AABH (500+ members, 1995) is an association; BiH is absent from the list of UIA sections. Never add FBiH+RS together without saying so.

countries.body: Камара на архитектите в България

alternative_lists.nom: Съюз на архитектите в България (САБ) — association, section UIA

countries.notes: ЗКАИИП Act: design capacity (ППП/ОПП) is obtained compulsorily through the КАБ; “more than 4,500” architects, landscape architects and urban planners (official site, recorded from extracts — kab.bg serves a JS challenge to robots). The complete register is promulgated every year in the Държавен вестник (e.g. ДВ бр. 34 of 11.04.2023) → massive nominal list in PDF. UIA section = САБ (association), not the КАБ. ACE 2024: 4,000. CORRECTION 5 August 2026 (direct count of the Регистър 2026 in ДВ брой 10 of 27.01.2026, grade B→A): 3,571 architects with FULL ППП capacity (3,269 BG + 9 EU + 6 third-country + 287 under art. 230 ЗУТ) — the former “4,500+” conflated architects, landscape architects (318) and urban planners (27, in the corpus annexes) across all capacities; WARNING: volumes II-III (ОПП, restricted capacity) are in ANOTHER ДВ material, not yet harvested — 3,571 is an exact floor (a lower bound), not the КАБ total.

alternative_lists.nom: Cyprus Architects Association — « Μητρώο Αρχιτεκτόνων » public

countries.notes: Registration with the ETEK by branch (architecture) is compulsory; public catalogue of members. CAUTION: the UIA section is the Cyprus Civil Engineers & Architects Association (CCEAA), not the ETEK.

countries.body: Hrvatska komora arhitekata

alternative_lists.nom: Udruženje hrvatskih arhitekata (UHA) — fédération de 11 sociétés régionales

countries.notes: Public imenik with a displayed total: 2,998 active (4,078 including retired/dormant), recorded 2026. The title “ovlašteni arhitekt” is protected (2015 Act). Pitfalls: separate register for urban planners (do not add them together without de-duplicating); Croatia does NOT appear on the list of UIA sections checked in August 2026 (the UHA was nevertheless a member of it — to be re-verified). ACE 2024: 2,900 — concurs.

countries.notes: “Arkitekt” is unrestricted (the association’s FAQ); “arkitekt MAA” is the de facto protected title. “Cirka 6 000 medlemmer” (website, undated, consulted August 2026). countries.notes: The title is not protected, but the ehitusseadustik requires a qualification (volitatud arhitekt tase 7/8, awarded by the EAL) in order to take responsibility for a design → registration compulsory in order to PRACTISE under one’s own responsibility. Certificates can be consulted in the public Kutseregister; no export verified. Headcount = ACE 2024. Absent from the list of UIA sections (verified).

countries.body: Suomen Arkkitehtiliitto (SAFA)

alternative_lists.nom: FISE Oy — registre volontaire de compétences du bâtiment (consultable publiquement)

countries.notes: The profession is unregulated: neither a protected title nor compulsory registration — the designer’s competence is checked PROJECT BY PROJECT by the permit authority. FISE Oy maintains a public voluntary register (76 competence titles). “3 900 arkkitehtia ja arkkitehtiopiskelijaa” (SAFA website, students included, undated); ACE 2024: 3,900 as well.

countries.body: Ordre des architectes — Conseil national de l'Ordre des architectes
countries.notes: Law of 3 January 1977: title and practice reserved to those entered on the Order's register (kept by 17 regional councils). Ministry of Culture figure: “more than 29,500” in 2023 (primary source: the CNOA's Archigraphie 2024); ACE 2024: 30,600. No open data set of the Order's register: data.gouv.fr API search = 0 results (verified August 2026).
countries.uia_section: Conseil National de l'Ordre des Architectes (CNOA)

countries.body: Τεχνικό Επιμελητήριο Ελλάδας (Technical Chamber of Greece)
countries.notes: SPECIAL REGIME: architects registered with the TEE ALONGSIDE the engineers — 122,154 members across 15 specialities, of whom 20,236 are “αρχιτέκτονες μηχανικοί” (official page, undated, consulted August 2026). A practising licence plus TEE registration are both compulsory. Public search by name (Μητρώο). The UIA section is the TEE, not SADAS. ACE 2024: 17,000 — the TEE register also counts non-active members.

alternative_lists.nom: Union of Architects of Georgia (საქართველოს არქიტექტორთა კავშირი)

countries.notes: FINDING (verified on matsne.gov.ge, doc 32506, law “on architectural activity” amended 9 June 2026): art. 4 — only a certified architect will be able to sign off a project, transitional exemption until 20 December 2026; certifying body not yet designated — to be re-verified in early 2027. The MEKON névjegyzék is searchable, with no total and no export; scope widened since October 2024 (site managers) — inflated series to come.

countries.body: Royal Institute of the Architects of Ireland (statutory registration body)
countries.notes: Building Control Act 2007 (Part 3): title protected since 2007, RIAI designated “Registration Body”. 3,592 architects on the register as at 31 December 2024 (annual report verified); ~10% non-resident; ACE: 3,500. A dual role, institute + register — the count of “RIAI members” (4,805) differs from the statutory register.

In parallel, the HMS issues the löggilding of designers (Act 160/2010) — hms.is returned 429 when tested. No official headcount published; AÍ ≈ 400 members (association content, undated). Out of ACE scope.

alternative_lists.nom: Asociacioni i Arkitektëve të Kosovës (AAK, section UIA)

countries.notes: Law 08/L-012 creates chambers (Oda e Arkitektëve), currently being set up — in the meantime licences and the register sit with the ministry (UA 06-08/2023). Traps: the acronym AAK also refers to a political party; check whether the chamber has become operational since; the currency of the PDF is unknown beyond 2023. CORRECTION 5 August 2026 (direct count of the PDF): 1,133 persons (1,135 lines, 2 registrants printed twice; references A/0001-A/1135 continuous); the final Shënim states that entry on the register does NOT confer the Licence Profesionale (the Oda is not yet constituted) and the document contains NO A/B category — the earlier 1,116 “A and B licence holders” cannot be verified from this source.

countries.body: Certification by the centre of the Latvijas Arhitektu savienība; state register of būvspeciālisti in the BIS (Būvniecības valsts kontroles birojs)

countries.notes: A practice certificate is compulsory for independent practice (MK 169 of 20.03.2018); certification delegated to the LAS, public state register in the BIS. countries.notes: A micro-state with no chamber: a state licence (Berufsbewilligung) entered on the professional register — the official llv.li page returned 403 to the crawler, and no public consultation could be verified; no headcount could be found. The LIA (~175 members, engineers AND architects taken together) is not a registration body. Absent from the list of UIA sections.

countries.body: Lietuvos architektų rūmai (Lithuanian Chamber of Architects)

alternative_lists.nom: Lietuvos architektų sąjunga (union de création, distincte de la Chambre)

countries.notes: A chamber under public law (Act of 2006) for CERTIFIED architects — attestation and membership required for reserved acts (Architektūros įstatymas, 2017). Nominal list no. 247 of 25.06.2026 in PDF (272 pp., qualifications and sanctions): 1,392 attestations counted. No interactive search engine — a downloadable list only. ACE 2024: 1,300 — consistent. Absent from the UIA sections. countries.notes: Law of 13 December 1989 (reformed in 2020): a multi-profession professional order. OAI site (consulted August 2026): 511 established architects, 202 consulting engineers, 34 interior architects, 154 town planners, 14 landscape architects. The ACE estimates 700 (including employed and cross-border architects who fall outside the directory of established practices).

alternative_lists.nom: Асоцијација на архитектите на Македонија (AAM, section UIA)

countries.notes: Single chamber (Закон за градење, art. 39, founded December 2007): only овластен архитект/инженер may design/review/supervise; membership and entry on the register are compulsory once authorised (EUR 50/year, 5 years). ≈3,200 active authorisations for ≈7,000 members across ALL professions (membership page, undated) — architects not broken out, hence the headcount left empty. The online register requires a member login — no public consultation.

countries.body: Bord tal-Warrant tal-Periti (Periti Warranting Board)

alternative_lists.nom: Kamra tal-Periti (chambre professionnelle, membre UIA et ACE)

countries.notes: A unified “perit” profession (architect + civil engineer). Periti Act (Cap. 622, 2021): two lists — Perit Arkitett (1,157 names as at 31 December 2025, counted in the gazette) and Perit Inġinier Ċivili (1,122), with HEAVY overlap (they must not be added together). Nominal lists in the Gazette and as a downloadable PDF. The government site blocks certain user agents. Direct count from the gazette of 06.04.2026 (position as at 31 December 2025), carried out on 5 August 2026: 1,157 Arkitett warrants — the earlier figure of 1,122 corresponded exactly to the Inġinier Ċivili list in the same gazette. 934 periti hold both warrants; 1,345 distinct natural persons; 42 companies (P/44 printed twice). Time series: gazette no. 445 of 26.04.2022 (Kap. 390, the SINGLE list predating the split), counted on 5 August 2026 — 1,157 named warrants, 1,156 individuals as at 31 December 2021, plus 15 warrants carrying a number only; that is, 1,156 individuals (2021) → 1,345 (2025).

countries.body: Atestarea tehnico-profesională (Ministry of Infrastructure) — registers published by IP OATUCL
countries.notes: No professional order: State certification (HG 743/2024, E_permis register). The “Lista proiectanților atestați” (31 July 2026, verified) counts 906 proiectanți across all disciplines; 312 carry architecture domains (codes A.1-4/3a-d/34.2.x) — count carried out on the nominal PDF. The title is not protected; what is protected is the right to sign and to verify. A “Specialiști atestați” dataset is flagged on dataset.gov.md (id 19433), the portal being unreachable at the time of testing. Moldova is ABSENT from the list of UIA sections (verified) despite statements to the contrary; UARM ~300 members (secondary sources). Direct count of the Lista as at 31 July 2026, carried out on 5 August 2026: 308 certified in the “Arhitectură” domain (criterion: letters A.*, or domain 3 of HG 207/2022, or codes 34.2.* of HG 743/2024-499/2025) out of 906 designers across all disciplines; 329 if urban planning/spatial planning is included; nr. crt. continuous 1..906.

countries.body: Ordre des architectes de Monaco (Conseil de l'Ordre)
countries.notes: Ordonnance-loi No. 341 of 24.03.1942 + Ordonnance souveraine 3.269 of 12.05.2011. The complete nominal register is published in the Journal de Monaco (official gazette PDF); the Order's site announces 19 registered architectes libéraux (August 2026). Distinct categories (libéraux, agréés, honoraires); no UIA section. Time series: the Tableau de l'Ordre in JO No. 8713 (20.09.2024, 2023-2025 term) counts 23 architects by direct count (the JO labels them all as conseillers, the 4 of the bureau counted again) → 19 on the Order's site in 2026.

countries.body: Komora arhitekata i planera Crne Gore

alternative_lists.nom: Savez arhitekata Crne Gore (SACG, section UIA — site hors ligne)

countries.notes: The 2017 reform and then a new law: the “licencirani arhitekta” must be entered on the chamber’s register (examination + 3 years’ experience). alternative_lists.nom: Stowarzyszenie Architektów Polskich (SARP) — association créative, section UIA

countries.notes: 28,000 registrants, of whom ~22,000 are active (OA statement, press October 2024, ~800 new entrants a year); ACE 2024: 21,400 ≈ the active ones. Public diretório: search by name, number, regional section, municipality and status. No bulk export.

countries.body: Ordinul Arhitecților din România

alternative_lists.nom: OAR București — Tabloul teritorial consultable en ligne

countries.notes: Act 184/2001: title and signature right reserved, Tabloul Național al Arhitecților (TNA) managed by the OAR; ~2,700 members at its founding (2001), current total not published in open access — oar.archi blocks robots (403). The OAR (UIA section) ≠ UAR (the legacy association). ACE 2024: 6,200. Nr. TNA observed up to 13,784 = ceiling of historical national registrations. The national register remains geo-blocked. Headcount taken from the ACE 2024 sector study, the body itself publishing none.

countries.body: Architects Registration Board

alternative_lists.nom: RIBA — Royal Institute of British Architects

countries.notes: Architects Act 1997: only the TITLE is protected, the function itself is unrestricted. 38,981 registrants at the end of 2024 (ARB 2024 annual report as cited in the press; the ARB “2024 Year in Review” gives 41,886 at the end of 2023) — the fall is due to ~2,468 struck off for non-payment in 2024. The UIA section is the RIBA (57,000 members worldwide), not the ARB. The register is searchable but there is no bulk export.

countries.body: Союз архитекторов России (voluntary union — no compulsory professional order)

alternative_lists.nom: НОПРИЗ — Национальный реестр специалистов (projeteurs responsables, ingénieurs inclus)

countries.notes: No compulsory professional order and no protected title: individual licensing disappeared in 2007. Actual access to the profession runs through the company SROs and the Национальный реестр специалистов (НОПРИЗ) for design project leads — portal verified, no headcount displayed, and it includes engineers. The САР (voluntary union, UIA section — still listed) publishes a public database: “Общее количество членов союза: 11 180” (2026 counter).

countries.body: Ordine degli Ingegneri e degli Architetti della Repubblica di San Marino
countries.notes: A joint order of engineers + architects (Decreto 63/1995). The albo is public online and can be filtered: 90 iscritti, of whom 45 are “Architetto” (count of August 2026). A special albo for non-residents. Not in the UIA and out of ACE scope.

countries.body: Inženjerska komora Srbije (national register of licence holders, on behalf of the MGSI ministry)
countries.notes: Since 2019 licences (licencirani arhitekta) have come under the MGSI; the IKS maintains the Registar under an agreement of 28 February 2020. The register holds 30,028 registrants across ALL professions (2021, press), of whom 14,892 active — architects are not broken out publicly, hence the headcount left empty (the ACE’s 2024 estimate is 3,300 architects). Public search by name, no bulk list; nothing on data.gov.rs (API: 0 results). Two domains coexist (ingkomora.rs / ingkomora.org.rs). UIA section via the UAS. Headcount taken from the ACE 2024 sector study, the body itself publishing none.

countries.body: Slovenská komora architektov

alternative_lists.nom: Archinfo.sk — portail et annuaire des architectes slovaques

countries.notes: Chamber created by Act 138/1992 (architects + landscape architects); authorisation compulsory, protected title. No aggregate count found (the zoznamy are JS-driven, with no total) — ACE 2024 estimates 1,900. The UIA section is Spolok architektov Slovenska (SAS, an association); sasarch.sk unreachable (TLS) when tested. Headcount taken from the ACE 2024 sector study, the body itself publishing none.

countries.body: Zbornica za arhitekturo in prostor Slovenije
countries.notes: 1,111 members of the architects' section (the title “pooblaščeni arhitekt” is protected, ZAID Act) out of 1,806 ZAPS registrants (1,335 active, 471 inactive — official statistics page, undated). Pitfall: the imenik requires a login (verified) — no public search; the chamber also covers landscape architects and spatial planners: do not take the ZAPS total for the number of architects. ACE 2024: 1,600.
countries.uia_section: Chamber of Architecture and Spatial Planning of Slovenia (ZAPS)

countries.body: No national professional order — REG (voluntary A/B/C registers, Fondation des Registres suisses) + cantonal regimes in GE/TI/VD

alternative_lists.nom: SIA — Société suisse des ingénieurs et des architectes

countries.notes: Title not protected at federal level, no national obligation. REG = voluntary registers recognised by the Confederation. Cantonal exceptions: GE (LPAI, compulsory register of appointed professionals), TI (LEPIA, OTIA registration — public list at otia.swiss), VD (LPrA 1966, REG A/B required to sign plans). Headcount = ACE 2024, revised from 9,200 to 26,700 with the Conférence Suisse des Architectes (CSA), which is the UIA section.

countries.body: Sveriges Arkitekter (Architects Sweden)
countries.notes: No professional order and no state register: “arkitekt” is NOT a protected title. Only the membership titles “Arkitekt SAR/MSA” (SIR, LAR, FPR) are protected, through the association. 14,022 members in September 2025 = architecture + interior + landscape + urban design, students included; 10,028 full members; ~90% of the profession. ACE 2024: 7,600 building architects. No public directory of individuals.

countries.body: Česká komora architektů

alternative_lists.nom: Obec architektů (section UIA, site redirigé vers Grand Prix Architektů)

countries.notes: 4,288 authorised architects as at 1 January 2026 (3,071 men / 1,217 women) + 207 emeritus members; the title “autorizovaný architekt” is protected (Act 360/1992). Pitfalls: the UIA section is Obec architektů, not the ČKA; buildings are also signed by ČKAIT authorised engineers. Public database (~290 pages) with no export.

countries.body: TMMOB Mimarlar Odası (Chamber of Architects, within the Union of Chambers of Turkish Engineers and Architects)
countries.notes: 98,872 members as at 31 December 2025 (46,443 women / 52,429 men) — official TMMOB table verified; 80,789 at the end of 2023. Membership compulsory for private practice and for signing (Acts 6235 and 3458), but public-sector employees are exempt. No public nominal register: verification through the şubes (branches). Pitfall: interior architects have their own chamber — do not add them together.

countries.body: State professional certification (Атестаційна архітектурно-будівельна комісія) — ЄДЕССБ register

alternative_lists.nom: Національна спілка архітекторів України (НСАУ) — union créative, section UIA

countries.notes: Qualification certificate compulsory in order to practise independently (official Дія guide verified); the title in itself is not protected. Public search of certified persons on e-construction.gov.ua (verified), no total displayed — headcount null (ACE 2024 estimates 3,700). Pitfalls: the old НСАУ “реєстр” page is dead; data.gov.ua datasets are likely but unverified; updates disrupted by the war. Headcount taken from the ACE 2024 sector study, the body itself publishing none.
countries.uia_section: National Union of Architects of Ukraine

countries.body: Registration by state/territory: 8 boards (NSW ARB, ARBV…); standards and aggregation by the Architects Accreditation Council of Australia
countries.notes: NO consolidated national register: the AACA “Industry Profile” (February 2018, verified) = 13,567 cumulative registrations at the end of 2017, i.e. ~11,800 UNIQUE architects (cross-state double registrations ~13%) — “~14,000” circulates for recent years with no up-to-date official source (the AACA 2024-25 annual report does not publish one). State registers are searchable (NSW verified). UIA: AIA.

countries.body: Fiji Association of Architects (regime reported under the Architects Act, Cap. 268)
countries.notes: The Architects Act (Cap. 268) is reported but has not been verified in a primary source; no active site and no public register. Headcount unknown — a few dozen.

countries.body: New Zealand Registered Architects Board (Registered Architects Act 2005)

alternative_lists.nom: Te Kāhui Whaihanga New Zealand Institute of Architects (NZIA)

countries.notes: The NZRAB site displays “Registered (2436)” live, plus 238 in voluntary suspension (5 August 2026) — the register is searchable and broken down by region. Only the TITLE is protected: design work is not reserved (hence registration is not compulsory). UIA: NZIA.

countries.notes: A registration regime (late 1980s) is reported but has not been verified online; no active official site and no public register. Headcount unknown — probably a few dozen.
